minors.issue: ORDER BY name uses the database collation, so SQLite (binary) and Postgres (locale collation such as en_US.utf8, which ignores '-' at the first level) can return the same names in different orders.
minors.scenario: Projects named "a-c" and "ab": SQLite lists a-c before ab ('-' is 0x2d), while Postgres with an en_US collation lists ab before a-c. The conformance suite only uses names without hyphen ties, so it passes on both backends.
